notes: Research artifact only — no trades, quotes, swaps, or risk changes.
CMC ranks/vetoes only; the scanner is the SOLE setup authority.
Missing CMC/market data is recorded as a reason; never substituted with stale or future values.

Cross-sectional 7d ranks are computed over RESOLVED-identity, scanner-scannable, non-stale, non-vetoed rows only; ambiguous/unresolved-identity tokens never influence ranks or the top-quartile threshold.

active_watchlist requires scanner authorization AND resolved identity; authorized-but-ambiguous/unresolved rows route to monitor_only with 'not_gold_execution_identity' and can never be execution-eligible.
Counter-bias longs are retained as discovery ONLY when the 7d observation is positive AND top-quartile; negative-7d counter-bias rows are not discovery candidates.

stale_market_data enforced FAIL-CLOSED: a CMC quote is fresh ONLY when its last_updated is present, parseable, and within 24h of snapshot retrieval. A missing/malformed/unparseable last_updated (or indeterminate retrieval time) is treated as stale_market_data — excluded from ranks and unable to support activation/discovery; never assumed fresh.

Provenance guard: run_metadata records filter_commit (the commit reproducing this artifact) and scanner_engine_commit (the engine parity baseline) as distinct fields; the run FAILS CLOSED if the filter script or scanner engine source has uncommitted changes at scan time, so a recorded clean SHA always reproduces the output.
cmc_veto enforced: is_active==0 (inactive/delisted) OR 24h USD volume below $50,000 bars a token from active_watchlist/discovery (CMC vetoes, never authorizes).
Stablecoin/pegged rows are non-directional and never scanner candidates.
monitor_only and pinned monitoring are NOT authorization to trade.
